'''Trea Kobbeth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Trea Kobbeth and her son, [[Viyo Kobbeth|Viyo]], were among the many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Kobbeth was grieved to discover her son had been abducted by a [[Flesh Raider]] in the [[Tythos Ridge]]. Approaching a young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] visiting the village, Kobbeth begged the apprentice to find her son. Young Viyo returned not long after, unscathed as the Flesh Raider simply wanted him as a translator.<ref name="TOR" />

She was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a man by the last name of [[Kobbeth]], a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Sergeant Kobbeth|Trea Kobbeth}}</ref> The Twi'lek man encountered an Imperial on Belsavis, who saved him and a member of his squad from an [[Esh-kha]] assault in exchange for a vault key.<ref name="Esh-kha Containment">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|Esh-kha Containment|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>
